# Configuration Reference

> ⚠️ **Generated page** — do not edit by hand. Run `make wiki` to regenerate.

Settings are read from environment variables (or a `.env` file / `CAP_*_CMD` secret-exec helpers). Names below are the env-var form.

| Env var | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAP_ENV` | CapEnv | `'demo'` | Environment: demo or live |
| `CAP_API_KEY` | str | **(required)** | API Key from Capital.com |
| `CAP_IDENTIFIER` | str | **(required)** | Login email |
| `CAP_API_PASSWORD` | str | **(required)** | API Key custom password |
| `CAP_ALLOW_TRADING` | bool | `False` | — |
| `CAP_ALLOWED_EPICS` | str | `''` | — |
| `CAP_MAX_POSITION_SIZE` | float | `1.0` | — |
| `CAP_MAX_WORKING_ORDER_SIZE` | float | `1.0` | — |
| `CAP_MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS` | int | `3` | — |
| `CAP_MAX_ORDERS_PER_DAY` | int | `20` | — |
| `CAP_REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_CONFIRM` | bool | `True` | — |
| `CAP_DRY_RUN` | bool | `False` | — |
| `CAP_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID` | str \| None | `None` | — |
| `CAP_PERSIST_SESSION` | bool | `True` | Cache the short-lived session tokens in the state file (0600) so back-to-back invocations reuse them instead of re-logging in (avoids HTTP 429). Set false to disable. |
| `CAP_HTTP_TIMEOUT_S` | float | `15.0` | — |
| `CAP_LOG_LEVEL` | str | `'WARNING'` | — |
| `CAP_WS_ENABLED` | bool | `False` | — |
| `CAP_PREVIEW_CACHE_TTL_S` | int | `120` | — |
| `CAP_PING_INTERVAL_S` | int | `480` | — |
